{{Top|leg}}
The '''airborne algae sack''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Algae/Legends|algae]] native to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. They were tiny, microscopic creatures who lived in the gas and clouds of Bespin and they spread like ordinary algae.
